import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set a style for better aesthetics
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(20, 7)) # One row, three columns for comprehensive view

# Add an overall title to the figure
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis by Transaction Features', fontsize=16, y=1.03)

# Plot 1: Distribution of 'amount' by 'is_fraud'
# Using KDE plot to show density distribution for continuous 'amount'
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud', fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis')
axes[0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Density')
# Customize legend labels for 'is_fraud'
handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = ['Not Fraudulent' if label == '0' else 'Fraudulent' for label in labels]
axes[0].legend(handles=handles, labels=new_labels, title='Fraud Status')

# Plot 2: Distribution of 'hour_of_day' by 'is_fraud'
# Using histogram with 'dodge' to compare counts for discrete 'hour_of_day'
sns.histplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', multiple='dodge', bins=24, shrink=0.8, ax=axes[1], palette='viridis')
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Activity by Hour of Day and Fraud Status')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (0-23)')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Set ticks for every 2 hours for clarity
axes[1].set_xlim(-1, 24) # Ensure full range of hours is visible
# Customize legend labels for 'is_fraud'
handles, labels = axes[1].get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = ['Not Fraudulent' if label == '0' else 'Fraudulent' for label in labels]
axes[1].legend(handles=handles, labels=new_labels, title='Fraud Status')

# Plot 3: Count of 'transaction_type' by 'is_fraud'
# Using countplot for categorical 'transaction_type'
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=axes[2], palette='viridis')
axes[2].set_title('Transaction Type Distribution by Fraud Status')
axes[2].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[2].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
# Customize legend labels for 'is_fraud'
handles, labels = axes[2].get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = ['Not Fraudulent' if label == '0' else 'Fraudulent' for label in labels]
axes[2].legend(handles=handles, labels=new_labels, title='Fraud Status')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles/labels, leaving space for the suptitle
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
